record.name: Minor Bugs to Fix - [PERSON_NAME_0050]
record.desc:
- [Red dots missing](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-539/implement-red-dot-for-cards-and-shop "‌")
- [Consecutive login quest not working](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-557/consecutive-log-in-quest-doesnt-work "‌")
- [Weekly star count has the wrong image](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-558/weekly-star-count-has-wrong-image "‌")
- [Hard crash](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-475/consecutive-glass-impact-sfxvfx-causes-crash-on-android "‌") bug on Android after consecutive glass VFX/SFX
- [Quitting level mid tornado boost breaks the object physics](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-554/quiting-level-mid-tornado-boost-breaks-the-object-physics "‌")
- [Refill algorithm spawns fewer items over time for both events. ](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-546/bug-refill-algorithm-spawns-fewer-items-over-time "‌")
- [Zombie track spawn is not consistent](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-438/investigate-why-some-zombie-tracks-do-not-spawn "‌") and causes level design imbalance.
- [Fast matching targets an already dead zombies](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-535/fast-matching-might-target-an-already-dead-zombie "‌").
  - it's still happens for samsung devices, that's why I couldn't repro.
- Premature ending in levels containing [USERNAME_4464] [\@‌[PERSON_NAME_0055]](https://harmonygamesgroup.Slack.com/team/U04TWDMDT0V "‌")
  - lvl 12, lvl 33, and lvl 93
- [On Android, if I home out during a level](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-559/homing-out-on-android-sound-disappears "‌"), and home back in, my sound completely disappears. And if I were to finish a level, I hard freeze at end game victory screen
  - Doesn't happen to me, might be again a Samsung issue but I need to see video
- [List of UI issues](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-498/fixing-ui-elements-on-home-screen "‌") listed for various parts of the game.
  - The[ trampoline UI](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-536/trampoline-icon-is-not-consistent-and-model-should-be-updated "‌") is not consistent across icons and 3d model.
  - Tornado icon is too low-res.
- The first time loss after [win streak doesn't reset](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-520/first-loss-as-level-doesnt-reset-win-streak "‌") the win streak.
- Poison effect in [kill cam causes perceived unresponsiveness](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-477/dot-kills-can-take-too-long-and-cause-perceived-unresponsivenes "‌") – UX feels frozen needs product decision.
- Zombie Health [bar persists too long](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-481/zombie-health-bar-persists-too-long-after-death "‌") which causes visual clutter along with miscalculated object targets
- [First loss as level doesn't reset win streak](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-520/first-loss-as-level-doesnt-reset-win-streak "‌") - happens only in lvl 21
- [Infinite lives from new-install are not granted,](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-483/infinite-lives-from-new-install-are-not-granted-rewards-30-min-in-the "‌") rewards 30 min in the next session start.
- [Quitting algo levels makes the level change animation](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-458/quitting-algo-levels-still-makes-the-level-change-animation "‌")
- [The abandoned pack win streak freezer reward is not granted. ](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-560/the-abandoned-pack-win-streak-freezer-reward-is-not-granted "‌")
- [On low-end devices, items surfaces vertical to camera is black.](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-561/on-low-end-devices-items-surfaces-vertical-to-camera-is-black "‌")

card.desc:
- Red dots missing
- Consecutive login quest not working
- [Hard crash](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-475/consecutive-glass-impact-sfxvfx-causes-crash-on-android "‌") bug on Android after consecutive glass VFX/SFX
- [Zombie track spawn is not consistent](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-438/investigate-why-some-zombie-tracks-do-not-spawn "‌") and causes level design imbalance.

  - it's still happens for samsung devices, that's why I couldn't repro.

  - lvl 12, lvl 33, and lvl 93

- [List of UI issues](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-498/fixing-ui-elements-on-home-screen "‌") listed for various parts of the game.
  - The trampoline UI is not consistent across icons and 3d model.
  - Tornado icon is too low-res.
- [Overheating](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-359/phone-heating-up-too-much-after-playing-15-to-20-levels "‌") still happens but it's in a better situation.
- The first time loss after [win streak doesn't reset](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-520/first-loss-as-level-doesnt-reset-win-streak "‌") the win streak.
- Poison effect in [kill cam causes perceived unresponsiveness](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-477/dot-kills-can-take-too-long-and-cause-perceived-unresponsivenes "‌") – UX feels frozen needs product decision.
- Zombie Health [bar persists too long](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-481/zombie-health-bar-persists-too-long-after-death "‌") which causes visual clutter along with miscalculated object targets
- [Implementing videos to FTUE funnel](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-500/add-additional-step-to-ftue-at-level-start-with-overlay "‌")
